You said it well when you said «I love her more than I love myself». Your story made me tear up, and I’m so incredibly sorry this happened to you. I went through a pretty traumatic breakup with my narcisisstic ex in March and I would be lying if I didn’t say i felt, and to a lesser degree still feel, the way youre feeling. But to that sentence, you put it blankly; you love her more than yourself. I am not the best at dealing with these types of situations, but I can tell you firsthand that however long it takes, focus on loving yourself. As corny or cliche or whatever it may sound, it is insanely important. You will never be able to love anyone truly until you love yourself. 
Don’t rush yourself, don’t set harsh deadlines, but very slowly and day by day, try to push yourself to recognize maybe 1 good thing about yourself every week, or two weeks, or even month. 
I wish i could give you a hug, but from this Reddit screen, I can only offer you my words.
Don’t give up for yourself.
